title: Is it too early for Christmas displays? Here’s what shoppers in 4 countries say
summary: We asked shoppers in the US, UK, Germany and Brazil how they felt about the first Christmas displays in stores.
body_markdown:
-


We interviewed 79 shoppers in the US, UK, Germany and Brazil about the first Christmas display they saw in a store this year.


-


Early November was the most popular start date, picked by 44 of 79.


-


The perfect month varied by country: 17 of 20 in Brazil chose early November, while in Germany 9 of 19 would wait until mid-November.


-


Displays mostly got people planning: 46 of 79 planned a future purchase and 13 bought something on the spot.


-


Brazil bought right away, the UK made a list, Germany browsed and the US split 10 to 10 on whether it was too early.
